intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. This page compares recorded fees and 2023 placements from our database, and flags fee rows that should not be read as programme totals in {{year}}.

Amity University Lucknow vs Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University is a same-city private comparison. Neither side has an NIRF Engineering rank on this page, so the 2023 records and official fee notices have to do more of the work.

sections.heading: Amity University Lucknow vs Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity University Lucknow if you want the higher recorded 2023 figures on this page, at an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹45 lakh.
Choose Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University if a slightly lower recorded 2023 average is acceptable, at ₹5 lakh, with a highest of ₹30 lakh, and you have confirmed its official fee for your branch.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Amity University Lucknow's recorded B.Tech figures on this page include tuition and year totals from about ₹1.98 lakh to ₹3.66 lakh a year, depending on the programme. Treat these as recorded year fees, not confirmed four-year totals.

SRMU has recorded year-wise totals around ₹2.74 lakh to ₹3.04 lakh, and also some much lower tuition rows of ₹26,400 and ₹38,750. Those lower rows may be a semester, a category or a non-tuition charge, so we do not treat them as the full annual B.Tech fee.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

Amity Lucknow's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹6 lakh and a highest package of ₹45 lakh. SRMU's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹30 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Private universities in Lucknow often use their own admission tests, JEE Main, or direct Class 12 merit.
Confirm the current official admissions page of each university for tests, cut-offs and scholarships. Class 12 PCM remains the usual academic requirement.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Amity Lucknow is a campus of Amity University. SRMU is a separate private university in the same city.
If you already plan to stay in Lucknow, visit both campuses and compare the official fee, hostel and labs, not just the brand name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the 2023 records we hold, Amity University Lucknow has the higher average and highest packages.
SRMU can still be a fit if its official fee for your branch is clearer or lower than Amity's recorded year range. Do not budget from SRMU's ₹26,400 or ₹38,750 rows alone.
Neither college has an NIRF Engineering rank on this page. Use official placement reports before you decide.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for Amity Lucknow vs SRMU?

faqs.question: Which exams do Amity Lucknow and SRMU accept?
faqs.answer: No entrance exam is listed for either side in our records on this page. Check each official admissions page for JEE Main, university tests or merit-based routes.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Amity Lucknow and SRMU?
